notes.title: Working on next update (technical only atm)
notes.notes:
I want to clean up all technical issues before moving forward with content updates.

The black screen error appears to be resolved, as two users confirmed that windows media player (and XNA's dependence on it) was to blame. You can follow the bug thread to see how to resolve the issue for yourself.

At the moment I have the following queued up, and as I work on Block King (my next greenlit game) some of these are getting resolved simultaneously in both games:

-volume adjustment option
-full screen toggle
-screen size manual adjustment
-mouse going off screen sometimes
-better mouse graphic so easier to see with all backgrounds


If you have other technical issues you'd like resolved (non-content) please comment on this announcement and I'll try to work them in as well.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.004
notes.notes:
In game chat using the T button + enter to commit or escape to cancel.

It is likely that anyone playing right now as I post this will crash when you send them a message (until they get this update). Please refrain from using this until tomorrow, 9/16/2016.

notes.title: Patch 1.003 - First Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
life = lifemax after you return to life (was 25% of max life).

No more spam dying to fire because you spawned on it after dying and defeating the boss of world 2.

Cleaned up mulitplayer code so information from previous games don't blend together. This led to interesting things like bosses in the home area where no enemies should spawn. Please report if this still happens.

Fixed error when exiting the vault and opening inventory afterwards. Was rare but got it fixed.
